name: Dashboard card
what: A dark app card swings in in 3D, its total counts up, a change badge pops, bars grow with a highlight walking across them (or a line with a soft area); the card floats with a slow tilt.

learned_from.what: a dark dashboard card, a money total, an orange highlight moving across the bars
a balance card with a line chart tilting in 3D

motion: in 22 f from a 28-degree tilt (S-curve); counts 40 f; bars 14 f, 3 f apart; the highlight steps every 14 f (8 f S-curve)
